manifest.name: dsh-plugin-brand-custom
manifest.description: Custom brand icon and name for the DeepSeek Harness Web client, editable live from a settings card

bundle.text:
# The layer this bundle contributes when a profile lists it.
#
# 1. Disable the official brand occupants (they only register in builds whose
#    DSH_CLIENT_BUILD_PROFILE is 'official'; single brand slots are exclusive,
#    and a second occupant fails the load). Skipped with a warning on profiles
#    that do not stack dsh-web-app.
- id: ui-brand-official
  disabled: true

# 2. Insert this package's own plugin row.
- insert:
    - id: ui-brand-custom
      name: dsh-plugin-brand-custom

readme.text: Custom brand icon and name for the DeepSeek Harness Web client — replaces the sidebar brand mark/name and the conversation hero mark, with a settings card to change them live, no rebuild and no reload.

- Occupies the `sidebar.brand.mark`, `sidebar.brand.name`, and `conversation.hero.brand.mark` slots with a custom icon and name, and swaps the browser favicon to match.
- **Settings card on the plugin's detail page** (Plugins → dsh-plugin-brand-custom): edit the brand name, pick an icon image (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/SVG, up to 256KB, previewed in place), and save — the sidebar, hero, and favicon update immediately. Reset restores the bundled defaults.
- Values persist in the profile's settings document, so every browser and every restart sees the same brand.
- Disables the official brand occupants (`ui-brand-official`), which only register in `official` builds; single brand slots are exclusive.
- Ships a bundled default icon from `src/client/assets/icon.png`, inlined as a base64 data URL by the tsdown build.
Requires dsh 0.1.7 or newer (the host serves the plugin's settings from its own Config schema there).

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-brand-custom
```

Or from the [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) plugin market inside the GUI: search "brand-custom", one click.

Restart `dsh web`, then open **Plugins → dsh-plugin-brand-custom** (click the card title) to reach the settings card.

Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-brand-custom`.

```sh
npm install --legacy-peer-deps   # type packages track the @deepseek-ai next channel
npm run bundle                   # tsc (lib/types) → tsdown (lib/client.js, PNG inlined as data URL)
```

`lib/client.js` is a closure-factory bundle (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`): the baseline modules (React, Cordis, ui-slots, ui-primitives) stay external and resolve through the shell's shared module table; everything else inlines. Those contracts are provided by the host shell at runtime, so the only runtime dependency is `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` (declared as a peer, supplied by the host profile).
